Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: In step 4, the WebSurfer agent failed to extract the correct birth date for Edward Sloman. The search results clearly displayed conflicting dates: Wikipedia and Find a Grave listed July 19, 1883, while IMDb and Kinorium listed July 19, 1886. The agent incorrectly consolidated these into a single date of "July 19, 1883" without acknowledging the discrepancy or verifying which source was more authoritative for the director of the 1964 film. This error led to the final conclusion that Elmer Clifton (born 1890) was born later, whereas if the correct date of 1886 had been used, Clifton would still be born later, but the accuracy of the data was compromised. More critically, the failure to resolve the conflict between 1883 and 1886 represents a data extraction error that undermines the reliability of the final comparison.
